## Section 1: Executive Overview and Scope
This document specifies mandatory compliance directives for financial institutions operating within digital banking infrastructure. 
All licensed entities must implement strict risk controls, maintain detailed audit logs, and adhere to capital adequacy thresholds established by regulatory authorities.

ablished by regulatory authorities.
Failure to maintain compliance may result in administrative penalties, operational suspension, or revocation of banking licenses.

## Section 2: Liquidity and Capital Requirements
Financial institutions must maintain a Tier 1 Capital Ratio of at least 10.5% at all times. 
Additionally, liquidity coverage ratios (LCR) must be sustained above 100% to ensure short-term obligations can be met during high-stress market events.
of net cash outflows and high-quality liquid assets (HQLA) is required by 17:00 EST.

## Section 3: Data Protection and Privacy Controls
Customer financial data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3 or higher.
Access control mechanisms must follow the Principle of Least Privilege (PoLP) and require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative operations.

## Section 4: AI Model Governance in Credit Risk
AI and machine learning models used for credit scoring and loan origination must undergo quarterly bias audits.
All automated decision-making pipelines must provide explainable outputs (XAI) detailing primary factor weightings for any adverse credit decisions.
